rationale: C21 plainly supplied concrete language and administrative machinery for the child. The child expressly recounts and quotes C21's September 10 request, then continues the same steel-dispute process by urging reliance on the Board's recommendations, extending work under existing collective-bargaining agreements, and keeping the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service available. C08 established an earlier stage of the same sequence, while C25 is closely related but contributes less of the child's actual drafting.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I urged that the parties give "the greatest weight and the most earnest consideration" to the recommendations of the Board "as a basis for prompt settlement" of their disputes.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: give the greatest weight and the most earnest consideration to the findings and recommendations of the three members of that Board as a basis for a prompt settlement of such disputes.
shared_material.explanation: The child reproduces C21's distinctive phrasing nearly verbatim and explicitly attributes it to the September 10 communication.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I requested the parties to observe the status quo until at least September twenty-fifth, saying "Obviously additional time is required by all, including me, for study and consideration of the Board's findings and recommendations."
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Obviously, additional time is required by all, including me, for study and consideration of the Board's findings and recommendations... [the agreements should] be extended by both parties at least until September 25, 1949.
shared_material.explanation: This is direct quotation and restatement of C21's operative request.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I also request the parties to extend the period for continued work and operations under the terms of existing collective bargaining agreements until 12:01 a.m. on Saturday, October 1, 1949.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: request at this time that the period for continued work and operations under the terms of such collective bargaining agreements be extended by both parties at least until September 25, 1949.
shared_material.explanation: The child reuses the same operative mechanism and formulation, changing only the extension date.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am requesting Mr. Chins to continue to make himself personally available in order to assist the parties in reaching agreement.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I shall expect the Director of the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service to make available to the parties every facility at his disposal in order to assist them in reaching agreement.
shared_material.explanation: Both direct continued federal mediation assistance as part of the agreement-extension process.
